title: Customer's monthly share of their own 2025 total
prompt: For each customer, what share of their full-year 2025 transaction volume happened in each month? You'll need both a customer × month grain and a customer × year grain before you can compute a share.
population: Transactions in 2025, joined through accounts to customers.
grain: transaction → account + customer × month → customer × year total → final: customer × month with share-of-own-year.
metricDefinition: (customer × month transaction total) / (that same customer's 2025 full-year total).
transformationPlan: aggregate transactions to customer × month totals (via accounts)
aggregate customer × month totals up to customer × year totals
join month totals to year totals by customer and divide
referenceSql: WITH customer_month AS (SELECT a.customer_id, date_trunc('month', t.occurred_at) AS month, sum(t.amount) AS month_total FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND t.occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY a.customer_id, date_trunc('month', t.occurred_at)), customer_year AS (SELECT customer_id, sum(month_total) AS year_total FROM customer_month GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT cm.customer_id, cm.month, cm.month_total, cy.year_total, cm.month_total / cy.year_total AS share_of_year FROM customer_month cm JOIN customer_year cy ON cy.customer_id = cm.customer_id ORDER BY cm.customer_id, cm.month
